name: WeightWaveHeadline
job: A headline in a variable font whose letter weight swells and relaxes in a wave that follows the pointer
visitor_action: move pointer across the headline to swell the wave; on touch a slow automatic wave sweeps left to right, with a quiet pause control
mobile: slow automatic wave left to right with a quiet pause control
motion: weights ease toward target with spring, wave radius falls off smoothly (reduced-motion: single medium weight, static)
art_direction: Type foundry poster: bone-grey ground, near-black grotesk, a single signal-orange underline bar, tight tracking
